item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera records the maximum and minimum air temperatures outside her school in Jaipur every day for a month. She notices that the values are not the same each day.
Which statement best explains her records?

options.A: The maximum and minimum temperatures must stay the same every day because the same thermometer is used.
options.B: The maximum and minimum temperatures usually vary from day to day because weather conditions change, and they generally rise as summer approaches.
options.C: The maximum temperature must rise every day while the minimum temperature must fall every day.
options.D: The maximum and minimum temperatures decrease day by day as summer approaches.
